# Build the dummy Dockerfile
exec docker build -qt dummy-updater .

# Reject unsigned images unless the development bypass is explicit.
! dependabot update go_modules dependabot/cli --pull=false --updater-image dummy-updater --proxy-image dummy-updater
stderr 'proxy image .*verification'
! stderr 'bin/run arguments'

# Run the dependabot command
dependabot update go_modules dependabot/cli --updater-image dummy-updater --skip-image-verification

# assert the dummy is working
stderr 'WARNING: updater, proxy, and OpenTelemetry collector image verification is disabled'
stderr 'bin/run arguments: fetch_files'
stderr 'bin/run arguments: update_files'

exec docker rmi -f dummy-updater

-- Dockerfile --
FROM ubuntu:22.04

RUN useradd dependabot

COPY --chown=dependabot --chmod=755 update-ca-certificates /usr/bin/update-ca-certificates
COPY --chown=dependabot --chmod=755 run bin/run

-- update-ca-certificates --
#!/usr/bin/env bash

echo "Updated those certificates for ya"

-- run --
#!/usr/bin/env bash

echo "bin/run arguments: $@"
